checks.title: Bracing Şr-2 profile total is overstated by 400 kg
checks.detail: Each row of the Şr-2 schedule prints a total of 404.40 kg, but 4 × 51.10 kg and 8 × 25.55 kg both give 204.40 kg. The schedule total of 808.80 kg should be 408.80 kg. Şr-1 on the previous sheet uses the same layout and adds up correctly.

checks.title: Warehouse slab area differs between structure and architecture
checks.detail: The structural schedule measures the ground slab at 1,109.10 m² (166.37 m³ at 150 mm). The architectural floor build-up uses the room area of 1,122 m², which gives 168.3 m³ of slab and 561 m³ of carbonate. The bill takes concrete from the structural sheet and the floor finish from the architectural sheet.

sources.quote: D1: Cilalanmış beton 56.1, Döşəmə qatı 168.3, Beton hazırlıq 112.2, Qırmadaş 112.2, Karbonat 561

checks.title: Admin ground slab is 100 mm on the structure and 150 mm on the architecture
checks.detail: Structural sheet KS-49 specifies a 100 mm slab with 18.1 m³ of B15. The architectural finish schedule lists a 150 mm reinforced concrete slab under every floor type: 10.84 + 12.43 + 2.23 = 25.50 m³. The bill uses the structural value until the designer confirms.

checks.title: Beam MR-2 volume is rounded up
checks.detail: One MR-2 beam is 0.84 m³ and there are six, which gives 5.04 m³. The schedule prints 5.1 m³.

checks.title: Electricity meter has no quantity
checks.detail: Row 4 of the warehouse electrical schedule lists a 380 V, 3 × 25 A meter with the quantity cell left empty. The bill leaves it out until a count is given.

checks.title: Earthing material weights do not match their lengths
checks.detail: A 40 × 4 mm strip weighs 1.256 kg/m. Row 14 (25 m, 32 kg) is consistent, but row 16 prints 20 m and 15 kg, where 20 m weighs 25.1 kg. Row 15 prints 3 m of Ø16 round bar at 36 kg; at 1.58 kg/m that is 4.7 kg. The bill measures earthing by length.

checks.title: Three admin electrical sheets carry the wrong title
checks.detail: The drawing index on MEP-42 lists sheets 2, 4 and 5 as general notes, lighting plan and power and earthing plan. Their title blocks read CCTV plan and communications plan. The register uses the index titles.

checks.title: Warehouse ventilation sheets are titled as the admin building
checks.detail: Sheets 10 to 14 sit in the warehouse set (cover on MEP-8 reads ANBAR BİNASININ İŞÇİ LAYİHƏSİ) and show the 48 m warehouse, but their title blocks read İnzibati bina. The register files them under the warehouse.

checks.title: Facade finish area is larger than the wall masonry
checks.detail: The four elevations schedule 1,245.0 m² of render and paint. The general notes measure 787.4 m² of 400 mm limestone walls. Confirm whether the facade area includes the gables and the band above +7.00.

checks.title: Column count matches footing count
checks.detail: Columns Ms-1 to Ms-4 total 21 + 4 + 4 + 2 = 31, which equals the 31 footings MB-1.

checks.title: Window count on the plan matches the schedule
checks.detail: The finishes plan shows 21 P-1 windows (8 + 5 on the long sides, 4 + 4 on the gables) and 3 Q-1 doors. The door and window schedule lists 21 and 3.

checks.title: Truss F-1 schedule adds up
checks.detail: The sixteen profile rows sum to 828.26 kg and the eight plate rows to 253.36 kg, as printed.

checks.title: Room areas, finish schedule and total agree
checks.detail: The seven rooms sum to 170.1 m², the total on the room schedule and the general notes. Rooms 1 + 5 = 72.32 m², rooms 2 + 3 + 4 = 82.88 m² and rooms 6 + 7 = 14.9 m², the three floor areas in the finish schedule.

sources.quote: Dəhliz 62.24, İşçi otağı 22.4, Nəzarətçi otağı 22.4, İclas otağı 38.08, Tambur 10.08, Sanitar qovşağı 7.45 + 7.45, Cəmi 170.1

checks.title: Downpipes agree between architecture and structure
checks.detail: Both the roof plan and the timber roof schedule give 21.8 m of Ø100 downpipe and 6 outlet funnels.

checks.title: Site layers are consistent with their areas
checks.detail: Gravel area 8,485.3 m² = lawn 2,532.3 + asphalt 5,549.0 + paving 404.0. Every volume equals area × layer thickness: gravel 200 mm, coarse asphalt 60 mm, fine asphalt 40 mm, carbonate 100 mm, topsoil 300 mm, cement-sand bed 100 mm.

sources.quote: Layihələndirilən sahə elementlərinin və istifadə olunacaq materialların təsnifatı

checks.title: Masonry areas agree between general notes and wall plan
checks.detail: External limestone 187.73 m², 200 mm partitions 149.27 m² and 50 mm partitions 13.7 m² appear in both the general notes and the wall types table.

gaps.detail: No excavation or cut-and-fill quantities. The excavation plans (KS-4, KS-41) give outlines but no volumes, and the grading plan is a flattened image.
Only the services sheets are issued for the two 100 m³ tanks and the pump station. Concrete, reinforcement and waterproofing need the structural drawings.
Not measured separately. The sample concrete rates for foundations and frame are all-in with formwork.
Thickness is given (100 mm, B7.5) but no area, so it is not billed.
Shown on foundation sections (2 layers of roofing felt in hot bitumen) without quantities.
No site water, drainage or power network layouts are in the package.
The package has no bill, rates or price base. The demo uses a sample AZN rate library that can be edited.
